title: Speed Run 3D
desc: Speed Run 3D compresses the slope feeling into glowing tunnels and one-touch movement. Patterns arrive faster every second, so clean runs come from rhythm, anticipation and calm hands rather than lucky swerves.
howto: Enter the tunnel and find a steady rhythm.
Move through the gaps in each pattern.
React early as the speed rises.
Keep your line centered where possible.
Restart fast and aim for a cleaner run.
tips: Read the pattern, then move once.
Do not chase a late gap.
